notes: Play a whole match on Burt Lake against up to three AI players, each Easy, Normal or Hard.
Online play: host a match and share its room code, or type a room code to join. Up to four players.
Fishing: cast, stop the lure at a depth, wait out the nibbles and hook the bite. Then hold the fish in the catch zone until the catch meter fills.
Thirteen Midwest fish in four tiers, from bluegill to lake sturgeon. Every hook is announced to everyone, and a legendary is announced late.
Ram a rival at speed to wreck their boat. They lose the fish on their line and start again from the spawn point.
Item buoys: six items, each used after a short minigame. Try the minigames from the Workshop.
The Fish-Boy comes up with Tab: the radar and its ping, the Fishpedia and My catch.
A countdown, the HUD, popups for hooks, landings and wrecks, and a postgame that shows each catch before the ranking.
Sounds for casting, hooking, reeling, pings, items and wrecks, and a rival motor that grows louder as it comes.
The underwater camera: light from the surface, weeds, rocks and logs on the bed.
New menus over a live view of Burt Lake. Settings now keep your name, the volume, the text size and the mouse between visits.
First version: the Title, Settings, What's New and a stand-in Play screen with a pause menu.
